spec.description: Argo CD application sync/health, sync activity and Kubernetes workload readiness. Last sync timestamps are not exposed by the current Argo metrics.

spec.title: Applications
spec.description: Number of Argo CD applications targeting the selected namespace.

spec.title: Applications out of sync
spec.description: Applications whose desired and live states are currently different.

spec.title: Unhealthy applications
spec.description: Applications currently degraded, missing, or with unknown health.

spec.title: Failed syncs (selected range)
spec.description: Failed or errored Argo CD sync operations in the selected time range.

spec.title: Applications by sync status
spec.description: Current application sync state, grouped by destination namespace.

spec.title: Applications by health status
spec.description: Current application health state, grouped by destination namespace.

spec.title: Running and ready
spec.description: Running pods with all containers Ready. Counts every pod in the namespace, not only those managed by Argo CD.

spec.title: Running but not ready
spec.description: Running pods with at least one container not Ready (failing readiness probe, CrashLoopBackOff). Completed job pods are excluded.

spec.title: Pending / Failed
spec.description: Pods stuck in Pending or Failed phase.

spec.title: Application status details
spec.description: Current Argo CD state per application. The exact last-sync time is not exported as a Prometheus metric: check it in the Argo CD UI.

spec.expr: sum by (name, project, dest_namespace, sync_status, health_status) (argocd_app_info{dest_namespace=~"$namespace"})

spec.title: Problem pods
spec.description: Pods that are not Ready, excluding Completed job pods.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",phase=~"Running|Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{namespace=~"$namespace",condition="false"} == 1)

spec.title: Sync operations by phase (5m)
spec.description: Argo CD sync operations counted over rolling five-minute windows, grouped by operation phase.

spec.title: Average sync duration by application
spec.description: Estimated average duration of successful syncs over 15-minute windows for the 10 most active applications.

spec.title: Healthy and synced applications
spec.description: Applications currently both Healthy and Synced in the selected destination namespace.

spec.title: Waiting containers
spec.description: Containers waiting to start, with the Kubernetes reason (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ...).

spec.title: Container restarts
spec.description: Container restarts in the selected time range.

spec.title: Degraded deployments
spec.description: Deployments with fewer available replicas than desired.

spec.title: Services
spec.description: Services in the selected namespaces.

spec.title: Services without endpoints
spec.description: ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer services with no ready backend pod.

spec.expr: (count(kube_service_spec_type{namespace=~"$namespace",type!="ExternalName"} unless on (namespace, service) sum by (namespace, service) (label_replace(kube_endpointslice_endpoints{namespace=~"$namespace",ready="true"}, "service", "$1", "endpointslice", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5}")))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Deployments
spec.description: Desired, ready and up-to-date replicas per deployment.

spec.title: Pods
spec.description: Every pod with node, phase, readiness, restarts and age. Completed job pods show phase Succeeded.

spec.title: Services
spec.description: Services with type, cluster IP and number of ready endpoints.

spec.title: Ingress routes
spec.description: Ingress host and path to backend service.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, ingress, host, path, service_name, service_port) (kube_ingress_path{namespace=~"$namespace"})

spec.title: Argo CD Monitoring
